comparison.objective: Place three personal devices on matching charging positions; candidate performs connector-terminal extraction.
comparison.physical_skill: Device pose placement and charging-coupling alignment versus contact-rich tool insertion, tang release, regrasping, and wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires all devices charging after release while the stand remains fixed; candidate requires selective extraction without damage or neighbor displacement. Candidate force limits are unmeasured.
comparison.reason: Charging-pad placement does not test mechanical retention release.
